run_EMG2PoseEvaluation_cli: run the EMG2PoseEvaluation CLI to evaluate a trained emg2pose model on the test split and save results to CSV
create_EMG2PoseEvaluation: create an EMG2PoseEvaluation dataclass instance with config, checkpoint, conditions, window length, and batch size parameters
evaluate_EMG2PoseEvaluation: evaluate a trained emg2pose model using PyTorch Lightning trainer and return a DataFrame of metrics per condition
get_dataloaders_EMG2PoseEvaluation: get a list of dataloaders grouped by conditions using WindowedEmgDataset with configurable window length and stride
create_results_df_EMG2PoseEvaluation: create a results DataFrame from a list of metric dictionaries merged with groupby condition values
